thread:
Maya R: FYI prod GPU nodes failing bootstrap after vault rotation at ~07:50 UTC. lots of 403s fetching keystore tokens.
Raj: confirmed, autoscaler churn in us-west-2. cost alert fired.
Carlos: sample log:
```
2026-03-23T07:51:10Z bootstrap: fetch keystore token -> 403
url=https://vault.prod.internal/v1/secret/data/prod/keystore/node-token
policy=keystore-tight-2026-03-23
```
Ben P: I deployed the tightened policy to reduce blast radius but accidentally removed artifact-service from allowed principals. pushing rollback now.
Steve (security): we also disabled the audit exporter during change to reduce noise. that was a mistake, we lost some audit coverage for ~20m. opening exception.
Maya R: immediate pain is new nodes can't decrypt model blobs so they fail to join GPU pool. warm nodes stay healthy but capacity shortfall triggers on-demand spins -> +cost.
Ben P: temp mitigations: (1) create a short-lived fallback token bound to legacy path, (2) inject into k8s secret infra/fallback-bootstrap-token. doing dry-run then apply.
Carlos: command to re-enable audit exporter (if needed):
kubectl -n infra patch deployment audit-exporter -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"exporter","env":[{"name":"EXPORTER_ENABLED","value":"true"}]}]}}}}'

Ben P: fallback token created and secret injected. nodes are starting to pull artifacts. seeing joins.
Raj: cost alert downgraded at 08:40 but we'll need postmortem.
Nina (compliance): compile what logs we have, document audit gap, and include emergency exception details.
Steve (security): follow-ups: add artifact-role smoke test to vault rotation runbook, require policy-diff validator, and gate audit toggles with two-person approval.
Maya R: opened PLT-5301 for playbook updates and owners. ops-bot: created incident INC-2026-0312-VAULT-ROTATE.
